caption: The drawing depicts a single candle holder with a candle, shown in the center of the image. The candle is a pale yellow color and is positioned at the top of a metal holder. The candle holder has a round tray with a scalloped edge, rendered in a silvery grey. Below the tray is a short, cylindrical stem separated by a red band, followed by decorative, elongated metal leaves extending downward. The body of the holder features additional metal elements and another set of downward-pointing elongated leaves, also in silvery grey. The base consists of two stacked, spherical red sections with faceted surfaces, which are broader than the rest of the holder, providing stability. The composition is vertically oriented, with the candle and holder centered on a plain, light background. The artist's signature, "Juanita Boforado," is located in the lower right corner.
title: Candlestick (One of a Pair)
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
